summary: Master advanced AutoCAD techniques with our comprehensive training course. Learn from industry experts and take your skills to the next level.
lede: Advanced AutoCAD training is for users who know basic commands and need to create and manage more complex drawings. It covers parametric design with geometric constraints, drafting automation using dynamic blocks and AutoLISP, and collaboration through external references and CAD standards. Learners also explore advanced annotation and dimensioning, plus 3D modeling and visualization at an operational level.

Troubleshooting, Optimization, and CAD Best Practices
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of basic AutoCAD commands (lines, circles, layers, dimensions, blocks) and ability to navigate the interface. No prior coding experience is required for the AutoLISP introduction, but logical thinking is beneficial. Technical Requirements: Participants must bring a laptop with AutoCAD 2024+ installed (admin rights required for customization) and have 8GB RAM minimum. A pre-course checklist with software setup instructions is provided 7 days before the start.
